description: This file defines a mock class COMLinkMock used for unit testing, mimicking the WPEFramework::PluginHost::IShell::ICOMLink interface. It includes mock methods for registration, unregistration, remote connection access, and object instantiation.

classes.name: COMLinkMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the ICOMLink interface for unit testing, providing mocked methods for connection and notification management.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks registration of a remote connection notification or a standard notification.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks unregistration of a remote connection notification or a standard notification.

methods.name: RemoteConnection
methods.description: Returns a mocked remote connection object given a connection ID.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Mocks the creation of an object based on the WPEFramework RPC object, returning a pointer and updating the provided size reference.
